creative_direction.concept: Precision Ledger — a bright, editorial layout with generous whitespace, confident teal accent, and typographic hierarchy that signals rigor over hype.
creative_direction.audience_and_context: Crypto founders, protocol teams, Web3 product leads, and growth marketers evaluating partners on desktop first (work hours), then mobile from Twitter/Telegram links. They scan for proof (case studies, metrics), credibility (logos, social), and a fast path to book a call.
directions_considered: Precision Ledger (light editorial): asymmetric grid, serif-influenced grotesk headings, neutral surfaces, one bold teal accent, proof-first storytelling.
Terminal Graph (dark terminal): code-inspired canvas with monospace accents, neon focus states, network graph motifs animating on scroll.
Bento Orbital (modular bento): dense, asymmetric blocks with interactive previews, color-coded capability tiles, subtle depth and hover reveals.
creative_direction.chosen_direction_rationale: We chose Precision Ledger because crypto services often default to dark neon aesthetics that can feel hype-driven. A bright, editorial direction differentiates immediately, improves trust, and foregrounds proof (metrics, case studies) with clarity. It photographs well, feels premium, and performs better for scanning on large displays.
creative_direction.typography: Google Fonts pairing: Display — Sora (600–700), Text — IBM Plex Sans (400–600). Numeric setting: font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums for metrics. Modular type scale (px/line-height): Display-XXL 64/72, Display-XL 56/64, H1 48/56, H2 36/44, H3 28/36, H4 22/30, Body-L 18/28, Body 16/26, Caption 14/22, Micro 12/18.
creative_direction.spacing_and_layout: 4/8px rhythm. Container max-widths: 1280 content, 1440 full-bleed media. Grid: 12 columns at ≥1280 (gutter 24), 8 columns at 768–1279 (gutter 20), 4 columns at 360–767 (gutter 16). Section vertical spacing 96–160px desktop, 64–96px tablet, 48–80px mobile. Text measure 60–72ch for longform.
creative_direction.shape_and_elevation: Radii: 4 (inputs), 8 (buttons), 12 (cards), 20 (feature media), 999 (pills). Borders: 1px solid var(--color-border). Elevation: low 0 1px 2px rgba(16,24,40,0.06), mid 0 8px 24px rgba(16,24,40,0.08), high 0 16px 40px rgba(16,24,40,0.12).
creative_direction.motion: Durations: 150ms tap, 200ms hover, 250–300ms section reveal, 300–450ms marquee loop easing. Curves: ease-out cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1), standard cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1). Reduce motion: disable marquee, swap reveals for instant fade with 1ms duration and no parallax.
creative_direction.signature_moment: Block Confirmation Reveal: each featured case study enters as a 'pending block'—a thin progress bar advances from Mempool to Confirmed (labels read by screen readers). On confirmation, a crisp teal check chip slides in and the case metric ticks up with tabular numerals. Reduced-motion users see the confirmed state instantly.
creative_direction.iconography_and_imagery: Icon style: outline, 1.75px stroke, rounded caps (Lucide-style). Use purposeful icons only (strategy, design, engineering, growth). Imagery: real product shots, dashboards, code snippets, selected chain visualizations; avoid coin clipart. Use subtle monochrome overlays to unify mixed sources.
creative_direction.voice_and_tone: Direct, evidence-led, confident without hype. Short headlines, specific subcopy, verbs over adjectives. Replace 'Get started' with outcomes (Book discovery call, See the work).
avoid: Three identical feature cards with emojis
Overusing glassmorphism or heavy drop shadows

screens: Top utility bar: Full-bleed bar on background with a left-aligned dismissible note 'Now booking Q4 builds' and a right-aligned live ticker chips (ETH, BTC, Gas). Layout: 12-col grid, content spans columns 2–12. Ticker chips are pills with small icon, label, value; auto-scroll pauses on hover and when focused.

Global navigation: Sticky surface with logo (left), primary nav (Work, Services, Approach, Insights), secondary actions (Book call — primary, Email — text). Desktop: inline menu with 24px spacing; Mobile: hamburger reveals full-screen drawer with the same order plus social links. Focus ring visible, 44px targets.

Hero: Left-aligned headline (Display-XL) 'Ship credibly in crypto.' with subcopy (Body-L) 'We design, build and grow Web3 products for teams who move fast and care about trust.' Primary CTA 'Book discovery call' (accent), Secondary 'See our work' (text + arrow). Right: feature media area (card radius 20) cycling 2–3 real case thumbnails; marquee of client logos sits beneath hero on surface with low elevation. Grid: text spans cols 2–6, media spans cols 7–12. Mobile: stack text above media.

Proof strip / logo wall: Horizontally scrolling (or paged) monochrome client logos on surface with 1px top and bottom borders. Includes 'Trusted by' label. Logos size-clamped and grayscale; hover reveals original tone by 10%. Keyboard accessible with previous/next buttons.

Services overview: Four capability tiles in a 12-col grid (each 3 cols): Strategy, Product Design, Engineering, Growth. Each tile: icon, H3 title, 2-line description, 'Explore service' inline link. Hover: subtle lift + 1px accent border. Mobile: 2-wide grid then stack.

Featured case study: One hero case with large image (16:9), client name, project title, 2–3 bullet outcomes, and 3 metric stats (e.g., TVL, conversion, time to ship). CTA 'Read case study'. Signature 'block confirmation' animation on reveal. Layout: media full-bleed to 1440 with caption and content constrained to 960.

Case studies grid: 2x2 or 3x2 cards depending on viewport. Each card: image, tag pills (Chain, Service), title, 1-sentence result, metric chip. Hover: image pans 4%, accent border appears, title underlines. Filter chips above (All, DeFi, Infra, NFT, Exchange).

Approach: Three steps horizontally with connective line: 1 Discover (audits, brief), 2 Build (sprints), 3 Prove (launch, optimize). Each step has a short paragraph and a tiny deliverable list. Includes 'See our process' link. On mobile, steps stack with the line condensed to a left-side rule.

Testimonials + proof: Carousel of 2–3 quotes with headshots, name, role, logo. Each quote < 220 chars. Carousel arrows and pagination dots; swipeable on touch; keyboard arrows supported. Below: hard metrics row (Projects shipped, Chains supported, Average launch time).

Insights teaser: Three articles/cards with category, title, 2-line excerpt, 'Read' link. Includes a newsletter input (email + subscribe) with anti-spam note. Cards support 'time to read' and author initials avatar.

Lead capture / CTA: Split section. Left: H2 'Tell us what you’re building.' + short copy. Right: compact form with fields (Name, Work email, Company, What you need — multi-select chips, Budget range — select, Message), privacy consent, primary 'Send brief'. Success state routes to calendar link 'Book time now'.
FAQ: Accordion of 6 items: budget, timelines, chains, audits, engagement models, pricing. Single-open by default, all-collapsible. Chevron rotates. Content area supports links.

Footer: Four columns: Brand + short mission, Services, Work, Company (About, Careers), Contact (email, socials). Bottom row: legal (©, terms, privacy), a plain-language disclaimer on market data accuracy, and region note.
components: Header/Nav: Anatomy — Logo, NavList (Work, Services, Approach, Insights), CTAPrimary (Book call), CTAText (Email), MobileMenuButton, Drawer (mobile). Variants — sticky, transparent-on-hero, solid; Mobile drawer light/dark overlay. Tokens — spacing md-lg, color surface, border bottom, elevation low.

Button: Anatomy — label, leadingIcon (optional), trailingIcon (optional). Variants — Primary (accent), Secondary (surface with border), Tertiary (text), Destructive, Disabled, Loading with spinner. Sizes — L 48px, M 44px, S 36px. Tokens — radius 8, gap 8, padding 12–20, motion 150–200ms.

Chip: Anatomy — container pill, icon (optional), label. Variants — Filter (selectable), Metric (with strong number), Ticker (live price with tiny arrow), Tag (Chain/Service). Tokens — radius 999, padding 6–10, font Caption/12–14.
Logo ticker: Anatomy — track, items, pause-on-hover, prev/next buttons (visually subtle). Variants — auto-scroll, paged. Tokens — motion 300–450ms, color muted-text for mono logos.
Tile/Service card: Anatomy — icon, title (H3), description, link. Variants — default, hover focus-lift, selected (if navigated). Tokens — radius 12, border 1, elevation low, padding 24.

CaseStudy card: Anatomy — media (16:9), tags, title (H4), blurb (2 lines), metric chip, link area. Variants — default, hover, focus, loading skeleton. Tokens — radius 12–20 media, overlay gradient 0–8%, motion 200–250ms.

Metric stat: Anatomy — label (Caption), value (H3 with tabular nums), delta (up/down with color). Variants — positive, neutral, negative. Tokens — success/warning/danger colors, font-variant-numeric tabular-nums.
Step item: Anatomy — index badge, title, body, connector line. Variants — compact (mobile), expanded (desktop). Tokens — border, muted-text, spacing lg.
Testimonial: Anatomy — quote text, person (avatar, name, role), logo, pagination. Variants — card vs full-width. Tokens — elevation low, radius 12, motion ease-out.

Accordion: Anatomy — header button, chevron icon, region panel. Variants — default, open, disabled. Tokens — border, radius 12, padding 16–24, motion 200ms height auto with transform/opacity (not height).

Form controls: Input, Textarea, Select, Multi-select chips, Checkbox (consent). Anatomy — label, input, helper text, error text. States — default, focus, error, disabled, success. Tokens — radius 8, border 1, focus ring 2px accent with 2px offset.
Toast/Inline notice: Anatomy — icon, title, body, close. Variants — success, warning, danger, info. Tokens — background tinted, text strong, border left semantic.
Pagination/Carousel controls: Anatomy — prev, next, dots. Variants — small (testimonials), medium (logo wall). Tokens — 44px targets, focus visible.
interactions: Hero CTA hover: Trigger hover/focus — button elevates (mid shadow), background accent deepens by 6%; Timing 180ms ease-out.
Logo ticker: Auto-scroll loop; Trigger hover/focus — pause; Buttons prev/next scroll by 4 items; Timing 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22,0.61,0.36,1).

Case confirmation: Trigger in-view — status bar animates Mempool → Pending → Confirmed with ARIA live region announcing each step; Timing 900ms total staged (300ms each). Reduced-motion: instantly set to Confirmed.
Service tile hover: Trigger hover/focus — 1px accent border fades in, card lifts 4px; Timing 200ms.
Filter chips: Trigger click/Enter/Space — toggle selected (single-select or multi based on group), update grid via CSS filter class or JS; Timing 150ms for visual state.
Testimonials carousel: Trigger click/arrow keys/swipe — slide to next; Maintain focus visible; Timing 280ms, easing standard.

Form focus: Trigger focus — 2px accent ring with 2px offset; Error on blur with helper text; Submit shows loading spinner on button and disables inputs; On success, inline success notice and calendar deep link appears.
Skip link: Trigger Tab from top — reveals 'Skip to content' link that jumps to main; Timing 0ms; remains visible on focus.
Header on scroll: Trigger 8px scroll — add subtle border-bottom and compress vertical padding from 24 to 16; Timing 180ms.
states: Buttons: default, hover, focus-visible (2px accent ring + 2px offset), active/pressed (accent darken 8%), disabled (30% opacity, no pointer), loading (spinner replaces icon, aria-busy).

Inputs: default (surface, border), hover (border darken 5%), focus (accent ring), filled, error (danger text, border danger), success (success border), disabled (dimmed, not interactive), placeholder (muted-text).
Cards: default (subtle border), hover (lift + accent border), focus-visible (ring), selected (if applicable), loading/skeleton (animated shimmer blocks), empty (fallback message and CTA).
Carousel: default, hover (buttons visible), focus (buttons show), disabled ends (dim prev/next), keyboard (aria-controls with roving tabindex).
Logo ticker: default scroll, paused (hover/focus), reduced-motion (no scroll; manual pagination).
Form submission: idle, validating, submitting (button loading), success (inline success + calendar link), error (inline field errors + toast).
Filters: unselected, hover, focus, selected (accent fill, on-accent text), disabled.
Accordion: collapsed, expanded (height auto via transform/opacity), focus-visible on header, disabled.
Global: 404 empty sections (no posts/cases) show on-brand empty copy and 'Send your brief' CTA.
Edge text: long titles wrap to 2 lines then truncate with ellipsis; tags wrap to new line; logos fit within max height with object-fit contain.

responsive: Mobile-first. 360–767: 4-col grid, stacked hero (headline then media), logo wall becomes paged with swipe, services in 2-col then 1-col, testimonial carousel shows one card, case grid 1-up, form uses full-width inputs. 768–1279: 8-col grid, hero splits 5/3, services 2x2, case grid 2-up, media max 960, nav inline. 1280+: 12-col grid, hero 6/6, case grid 3-up where content allows, featured media can bleed to 1440. All interactive controls remain ≥44px; text scales with clamp to maintain 60–72ch line length on wide screens. Images lazy-load with reserved aspect-ratio boxes to prevent CLS. Safe-area insets respected on iOS.

Contact form submission endpoint (name, email, company, needs[], budget, message, consent) with spam protection and double opt-in.
Newsletter subscribe endpoint (email) with GDPR-compliant consent and error handling.
Availability note flag for top bar (string + on/off) editable via CMS.
Analytics events: hero_cta_click, case_open, filter_change, form_submit_success, newsletter_subscribe.
acceptance_criteria: Typography uses Sora for display and IBM Plex Sans for text with the specified sizes; headings and body meet WCAG AA contrast on all backgrounds.
All interactive elements have visible focus rings and 44px minimum touch targets; skip link is present and works.
Hero loads with no layout shift; images use aspect-ratio boxes and lazy loading; Lighthouse CLS < 0.1.
Logo wall supports 12+ logos, auto-scrolls, pauses on hover/focus, and is operable via keyboard arrows.
Featured case study shows 'block confirmation' sequence; reduced-motion users see instant confirmation.
Service tiles, case cards, and testimonials exhibit hover/focus elevation and border state exactly as specified.
Case grid filters work without a page reload and announce state changes to assistive tech.
Form has labeled fields, inline validation on blur and on submit, and shows success state with calendar link; errors reference specific fields.
Color tokens are implemented as CSS variables and not raw hex in components; only one accent color is used non-semantically.
Responsive layouts: 1-up case grid on mobile, 2-up on tablet, 3-up on desktop; hero stacks correctly on small screens.
Performance: images served as AVIF/WebP with srcset; JS defers non-critical animations; third-party APIs cached.
No decorative crypto coin imagery; all imagery is product or outcome-focused; logos monochrome by default.
Accessibility: aria-live used for confirmation steps; carousels announce slide position; accordions use button semantics and aria-controls.
States: default, hover, focus, pressed, disabled, loading, skeleton, empty, error, and success are implemented for buttons, inputs, cards, and carousels.
